in_cohort_reviews.rationale: NIREUS BioNIR-002/Medinol evaluates BioNIR versus Resolute; HARMONEE VP-0601/OrbusNeich evaluates Combo versus everolimus stents. Shared PCI language does not establish a common protocol or cohort.
Different NCI study identifiers and treatments/diseases (gefitinib mesothelioma versus PS-341 solid tumors). Rare 8-gram coverage is 13%, below the declared copy threshold. No explicit lineage found.

Different organization protocol identifiers and distinct study descriptions/interventions; no shared protocol identity, explicit lineage or substantial rare copied eligibility block was found. Similarity is insufficient to merge. This is no-merge evidence at screening, not proof of independence.

UMCC 2015.024/University of Michigan tests gene-transfer therapy; PRO00039277/Medical College of Wisconsin tests pulsed radiotherapy. Shared glioma eligibility wording does not establish a common trial family.
WATCHMAN continued access and a venous-cannulation CABG pilot are different protocols, sponsors and interventions. Shared consent/clinical wording is not a family link.

external_links.evidence: CAP2 registry description explicitly identifies continued access during PREVAIL analysis/review. The external record identifies PREVAIL and Boston Scientific.
Cohort 3 description explicitly names KTE-C19-102/NCT02601313 for Cohorts 1/2. External record has matching KTE-C19-102, ZUMA-2 and EudraCT ID.
Cohort 3 description explicitly transfers remaining 15-year follow-up to KT-US-982-5968/NCT05041309. This creates a participant-overlap split constraint, not identity of all Kite protocols.

unresolved_links.evidence: BX43361 master screening study identifies eligibility for linked Roche trials but does not enumerate their IDs in the screened source. Already in the pilot-development reservation.
Rollover protocol 20250089 requires ongoing benefit from a closing Amgen sotorasib parent study. Parent IDs are not enumerated in the screened source. Add a conservative held-out exclusion.
